notes.text: Added a setting to enable split-screen mode (display message list next to message content)
Show a thread as unread/starred if at least one message is unread/starred
Modified the preview lines setting to allow disabling message preview in message list
Remember the scroll position of the message list
Fixed a bug that prevented third-party apps from reading the number of unread messages
Fixed a bug that caused the app to load too many messages when you clicked "Load more messages"
Updated Finnish, French, German, Dutch translations
